issues.explanation: Settings stores user input in public $name, $slug and $targetMembershipId without #[Validate] attributes and validates via rules() instead of the project's #[Validate] pattern.
Settings has GET mount 403 tests for non-owners but no direct Livewire unauthorized-call tests for save, delete or transfer by a non-owner.
phpunit.xml gains a hardcoded APP_KEY which is test infrastructure unrelated to the task contract.

conventions.evidence: Policies used everywhere ($this->authorize in Members.php:113,120,144,161 and Settings.php:231,240,249,267); #[Locked] Entity in Dashboard.php:68, Members.php:106, Settings.php:221; #[Validate] on Members email (Members.php:108); but Settings name/slug/targetMembershipId have no #[Validate] and use rules() (Settings.php:23-27,311-323). Migrations have reversible down(). Docs and CHANGELOG updated.

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (addMember, assignRole, removeMember in Members.php:118-172; save, delete, transfer in Settings.php:238-294); clear names (membership(), manageableRoles(), membershipFor); consistent policy docblocks; no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: entities migration has slug unique entities_slug_unique + softDeletes (change.diff:761-766) and getRouteKeyName slug (Entity.php:353); memberships migration has cascade FKs, role default employee, owner_seq storedAs plus both unique indexes (change.diff:799-809); EntityPolicy/EntityMembershipPolicy match role matrix; EntityPickController aborts 403 before session write, logs audit channel and redirects (EntityPickController.php:35-45); Dashboard/Members/Settings mount with slug binding and policy checks; lang keys nav_members/nav_settings/dashboard_owner_notice/Transferir propriedade present in both locales; docs/database-schema.md updated.

scope.evidence: Every new file serves the task: models, policies, EntityPickController, 3 Livewire components + Blade views, 4 routes (routes/web.php:1176-1181), 2 migrations, lang keys, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG, 6 Feature test files. No onboarding, switcher, middleware, navbar, queue or billing code. Only extra is phpunit.xml APP_KEY test setup.

security.evidence: Every action authorizes server-side (Members mount/addMember/assignRole/removeMember; Settings mount/save/delete/transfer); server-only Entity is #[Locked]; membership() scopes lookups to $this->entity->memberships()->whereKey with abort 403 (Members.php:181-188); transfer scopes target to entity, requires Admin role and non-caller with lockForUpdate (Settings.php:272-291); Blade uses {{ }} only; $fillable set on both models.

simplicity.evidence: Reuses UserRole enum with manageable(), Eloquent scopes owner/admin/employee, policies and existing x-form-field/x-button Blade components; no service/repository/Action layers or speculative abstractions; transfer and delete are minimal transactions in the component.

tests.evidence: 6 Pest files: EntityModelTest (columns, indexes, slug binding, soft deletes, second-owner and duplicate QueryException), EntityPolicyTest (role matrix + gates), EntityPickTest (happy, non-member 403 session untouched, audit mock, guest), EntityDashboardTest (owner links/notice, non-owner no settings URL, non-member 403 with session, guest, unverified), EntityMembersTest (add/duplicate/unknown-email, employee 403 on add/assign, owner-role validation error, cross-entity tamper 403, owner/last-manager 403, self-removal), EntitySettingsTest (mount 403, save, slug uniqueness, delete soft-clear, transfer happy + 4 forbidden targets). Missing direct non-owner Livewire calls to Settings save/delete/transfer.

review.summary: The change implements the full entities/memberships data model, policies, entity pick, dashboard, members and owner-only settings pages per the contract, with strong authorization, locked Livewire state and thorough Pest coverage including tamper tests. Minor gaps in Livewire validation style (Settings rules() vs #[Validate]) and missing action-level unauthorized tests for Settings keep it at approve-with-nits.
